description: Deterministic Renee/Charge bucket discriminator frozen before capture. WIP attacks minxxx with Renee 3/3/3, fielding 500 T6 Lancers into 1490 T6 Marksmen. Charge contributes 10% in type.single_target.damage.up on every Lancer-to-Marksman job. Using stats from the preceding Renee/Gwen capture, Renee in active.hero.damageTaken.up predicts WIP wins with about 52 Lancers because Charge and Renee multiply across buckets; Renee in type.single_target.damage.up predicts minxxx wins with about 49 Marksmen because Charge and Renee add within one bucket. Capture exact report stats, then rerun these unchanged candidate mechanics before interpreting the observation.
